messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Phenotypic var% (fitqtl)
parts:
Yes, %var = percent of the phenotype variance explained by the QTL.

est = additive or dominance effect (the row labeled 1...@61.8a has the additive effect of the QTL at 61.8 cM on chr 1; the row labeled 1...@61.8d has the dominance effect for that QTL).

t = est/SE. for example, 6.6032/8.6681 = 0.762

karl
